Permissions.Step1: 1. Click “Request access”: NexaDesk is added to the matching list in System Settings → Privacy & Security, and macOS offers to open it.
Permissions.Step2: 2. Turn NexaDesk on in that list. If it is not there, close and reopen System Settings (the list does not refresh by itself), or click “+” and add NexaDesk.app.
Permissions.Step3: 3. Come back here and click “Check again”.
